clue.text: Judo star from predominantly afro-Caribbean area?

definitions.text: Judo star from predominantly afro-Caribbean area?

parts.words: Judo star from predominantly afro-Caribbean area?
parts.note: a top judo expert wears a belt of a certain colour, and the same phrase could jokingly describe a district whose residents are mostly black

explanation.surface: A question about where a champion judoka grew up.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest-grade judo fighters are awarded this belt, so a judo star is one.

clue.text: Violent clouts from destructive creature

indicators.note: violent suggests the letters of clouts being thrown around into a new order

explanation.surface: Hard blows dealt by some ravaging beast.
explanation.definitionFit: Swarms of this insect strip crops bare, making it a byword for destruction.

clue.text: Hideout south of river somewhere in London

indicators.note: in a down entry, south of means placed below, so the hideout comes after the river

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge
a den is a hideout or lair

explanation.surface: A hiding place below a river, located somewhere in London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'south of' puts DEN beneath CAM in the down light. CAMDEN is a north London borough.
explanation.definitionFit: Camden is a borough and district of north London, so it is one place in the capital.

clue.text: About to drown in tub — losing this!

indicators.note: to drown in means to be submerged within, so one piece is plunged inside the other

parts.note: a bath is a tub for washing in
re is Latin-derived for about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone about to go under in the bathtub, losing what keeps them alive.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'this', pointing back to the whole scene: what someone going under the water loses.
explanation.definitionFit: A drowning person runs out of air in the lungs, which is the thing lost here.

clue.text: We hear lady-love's turned out to be a murderer

indicators.note: turned out suggests the letters of these words being turned over into a different arrangement

parts.note: taken letter for letter, the possessive S included, as the anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Gossip that someone's sweetheart has proved to be a killer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned out' looks like part of the gossip but shuffles all fifteen letters of WE HEAR LADY-LOVES. 'We hear' tempts as a homophone signal; it is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Lee Harvey Oswald assassinated President Kennedy in Dallas in 1963.

clue.text: Decisive contests? Go away, ticket spivs!

parts.note: shoo is an exclamation telling someone to go away
touts are people who resell tickets at inflated prices; a spiv is a British slang word for a petty black-market dealer

explanation.surface: Someone shooing off the ticket touts outside a big decisive match.
explanation.definitionFit: A penalty or gunfight decider settles a contest once and for all, so these are decisive contests.

clue.text: Gun company includes something for dressing wounds

indicators.note: includes means the company holds the dressing material within it

parts.note: a flock is a company or crowd, of birds or people
lint is a soft fabric used to dress wounds

explanation.surface: An arms firm that also supplies bandages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gun company' reads as an arms maker, but the definition is 'Gun' alone and 'company' is a crowd of sheep or birds.
explanation.definitionFit: An old firearm fired by a spark from a striking stone is this kind of gun.

clue.text: Overawed politician ensnared by naughty desires

indicators.note: ensnared by means the politician is trapped inside the rearranged letters
naughty suggests the letters of desires misbehaving and moving out of place

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An MP awed and caught out by improper urges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'naughty' rearranges the seven letters of the clue's 'desires' around which the politician is caught.
explanation.definitionFit: To be deeply struck or awed by something is to be impressed by it.

clue.text: Love only half evident in false form of greeting

indicators.note: evident in means one piece appears inside the other

parts.note: something sham is false or fake

indicators.note: only half of the word love is used, its first two letters

explanation.surface: A lukewarm display of affection in a fake greeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'false form' reads as one phrase, but 'false' is wordplay and 'form of greeting' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Shalom is the Hebrew word for peace, used as a salutation on meeting or parting.

clue.text: After jiggery-pokery French father and daughter made haste

indicators.note: after here means the father and daughter follow the trickery in order

parts.note: jiggery-pokery is British slang for trickery, so a scam
pere is the French word for father

explanation.surface: A French dad and his daughter hurried away after some trickery.
explanation.definitionFit: To scamper is to run quickly with small steps, so to hurry off.

clue.text: Woodworker is not one to stand aloof

definitions.meaning: a craftsman who makes wooden fittings such as doors and window frames

definitions.text: is not one to stand aloof
definitions.meaning: a person who readily signs up and takes part in clubs and groups

explanation.surface: A carpenter who is happy to mix with others.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpenter of fittings has this trade name, and someone who signs up to groups is also called this.

clue.text: Key set in seal needing to be broken

indicators.note: needing to be broken suggests the letters of set in seal being smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: A key set into a seal that must be cracked open.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' looks like a physical key in the seal, but it is an adjective, meaning vital.
explanation.definitionFit: Key as an adjective means crucial or indispensable, a synonym.

clue.text: Marshes in which one sees the alien goblins

indicators.note: in which one sees means the second piece is found inside the marshes

parts.note: bogs are marshes or wetlands
le is the French word for the, so a foreign the

explanation.surface: Marshland where one spots the aliens, or goblins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the alien' means 'the' in a foreign language, here French.
explanation.definitionFit: Bogle is a Scottish and northern English word for a goblin or spectre.

clue.text: A home set up with piece of furniture that's flexible

indicators.note: in a down light, set up means the word for home is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: pad is slang for one's home
a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: Setting up a home with a versatile item of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: Being able to adjust to changing conditions is being flexible, a synonym.

clue.text: Hurting the feelings of cricket side before the finish

indicators.note: before means the cricket side comes first, ahead of the finish

parts.note: the off side is one half of the cricket field, facing the batsman's bat
an ending is a finish

explanation.surface: A cricket team upsetting people just before the end of a match.
explanation.walkthrough: The off side in cricket is the half of the field the batter faces when taking guard.
explanation.definitionFit: To offend someone is to upset or affront them, so hurting their feelings.

clue.text: Usually at home — army officer

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in
a general is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: A senior army officer who is mostly at home.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means as a rule or on the whole, a synonym for usually.

clue.text: Woman always seen as deficient

indicators.note: deficient means lacking something, so the word for always is short of its last letter

parts.note: ever means always, as in ever hopeful

explanation.surface: A woman perpetually regarded as lacking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deficient' drops the last letter R from EVER.
explanation.definitionFit: Eve is a woman's name, the first woman in the Bible.

clue.text: Greek character in terrorist organisation

definitions.meaning: the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet
the Basque separatist armed group active in Spain

explanation.surface: A Greek figure serving inside a terror group.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a letter of the Greek alphabet and the acronym of the Basque separatist group.

clue.text: Organ costing a lot? Dean is put off

indicators.note: is put off means the dean is removed from the word

parts.note: dear means expensive, costing a lot
D is an abbreviation for Dean

explanation.surface: A pricey church organ that a cathedral dean finds off-putting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is put off' takes D out of DEAR. The surface pictures a church organ; it is a body part.
explanation.definitionFit: The ear is the organ of hearing.

clue.text: The specified object

parts.note: the word The is the grammatical device that marks a noun as a particular, specified one

explanation.surface: A grammar question about what the word The is.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar, the determiner the refers to a specific, already identified noun.

clue.text: Port always accompanies end of dinner

parts.note: ay is an old and poetic word for always

indicators.note: end of picks the last letter of the word dinner

explanation.surface: Port is always served at the end of dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: Port reads as the after-dinner wine but is a harbour town: AYR is a port on Scotland's west coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Ayr is a harbour town on the Firth of Clyde in Scotland.

clue.text: Young bird's eye

definitions.meaning: a chick that cheeps, especially a young chicken or pigeon
informal word for an eye, the organ one looks through

explanation.surface: A fledgling's eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A chick that peeps or cheeps is so called, and so, informally, is an eye that peeps.

clue.text: Individual assigned to each male member of family

parts.note: per means each, as in ten pounds per head
a son is a male child in a family

explanation.surface: A single person allocated to every man in the household.
explanation.definitionFit: An individual is a single human being, a synonym.

clue.text: Mean mother wanting boy in before one

indicators.note: in means the boy and the one go inside the word for mother

parts.note: mum is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: before means the boy comes ahead of the one

parts.note: Ed is a boy's name, short for Edward
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A stingy mother wants her son home before one o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' looks like miserly but is the noun: an average.
explanation.definitionFit: A mean is a midpoint or average, which is also called a medium.

clue.text: PM on the sheltered side keeping dry

indicators.note: keeping means holding the second piece inside the first

parts.note: alee means on the side away from the wind, sheltered
TT, teetotal, means abstaining from alcohol, or dry

explanation.surface: A Prime Minister staying out of the wind and off the drink.
explanation.walkthrough: TT is short for teetotal, someone who drinks no alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Clement Attlee was Labour Prime Minister of Britain from 1945 to 1951.

clue.text: Female guide has false teeth? Sure!

indicators.note: false suggests the letters of teeth and sure being faked into a new form

explanation.surface: A woman leading the way who has dentures, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'false' looks like it describes the teeth but rearranges TEETH and SURE.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who shows people to their seats in a cinema or theatre is one.

clue.text: See boy wander aimlessly

indicators.note: aimlessly suggests the letters of wander drifting into a different order

explanation.surface: Watch a lad roaming about without purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Andrew is a boy's name.

clue.text: Fellow's playing area will do for Notts football team

parts.note: a fellow is a man, so fellow's gives man's
a field is a playing area

explanation.surface: A man's pitch will be fine for a Nottinghamshire football side.
explanation.walkthrough: Notts is short for Nottinghamshire, an English county; Mansfield Town is a football club there.
explanation.definitionFit: Mansfield Town is a professional football club based in Nottinghamshire.

clue.text: Outside home tragical figure is one-dimensional

indicators.note: outside means the tragic figure sits around the word for home

parts.note: King Lear is the title figure of Shakespeare's tragedy
in means at home

explanation.surface: A flat, simple tragic character standing outside a house.
explanation.definitionFit: Extending along a single line, so having only length, is one-dimensional.

clue.text: Perhaps one stranger goes around stupefied

indicators.note: goes around means the first word surrounds the second

parts.note: odder means more strange
numb means stupefied or dazed

explanation.surface: An odd person wandering about in a daze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stranger' looks like a noun but is the comparative adjective. 'Perhaps' shows one is an example of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: One is an example of an integer not divisible by two.
